notes.title: Rolling Hamster's first patch
notes.notes:
Howdy people!
Rolling Hamster has been out for a little more than a week now, and we hope you like it so far! 
We were working on some patches for the game.
So, it's time for our first post on Steam ! 

We have a few things for you:

First let's tackle the content of the incoming patch

 The leaderboard now scrolls correctly!
 We changed the subheadtitle in the selection menu to be more clear about how to unselect an hamster


And with that, we also made a short video tutorial on how to use the new Remote play Together by Steam 
(which Rolling Hamster supports btw *wink wink*)
